Hi Jacob / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: SignalHealth is evaluating inference options for clinical summarization across your transcription pipeline. Key priorities you reiterated were predictable p99 latency, tenant isolation for PHI data, and straightforward model rollback.

Suggested next steps:
- 60–75 minute technical deep-dive focused on throughput/latency tradeoffs and deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).
- Bring in Marissa (solutions engineer) to walk architecture and run a short Q&A on KV cache/quantization tradeoffs.
- Share a mutual action plan (attached) and a short checklist for security/compliance items you requested.

Proposed windows (PST):
1) Thu Apr 22 — 9:30–10:45 AM
2) Fri Apr 23 — 1:00–2:15 PM

If either works, I can send a Google Calendar invite with a Meet link (or we can use your Zoom — let me know preference). I also attached a draft mutual action plan so you can see proposed owners and timelines.

Attendees we recommend from our side: Marissa Cole (SE), Ben Carter (AE) — are there any additional folks on your side who should join?

Thanks,

—Tessa
